meta.purpose: Invented preview for two design panels in Section 6.3; no measurements or fabricated uncertainty.
meta.representative_configuration: Yambda-Large, independent module calibration; illustrative values only.
meta.read_scope: Read FLOPs relative to native attention; AUC gain over Reuse. Width labels are stored coordinates / coordinates read per head.
meta.calibration_scope: Recovery after 256 causal appends on the same held-out histories. Each fitting count and tail-supervision setting is trained independently; users and evaluation trajectory are fixed.
meta.provenance: Width and constant-gate default values follow the current manuscript synthetic tables. Calibration values are invented layout examples, not a new experiment.

constant_gate.control: independently trained constant gate; same stored/read widths, fitting budget and held-out trajectory as dynamic 72/6
